name: ace of wands
symbols: a living branch offered from a cloud
leaves still sprouting off the cut wood
a castle far off, not yet relevant
themes: desire arriving before the plan
the spark that asks for a grip, not a strategy
raw beginning in the hand
shadow: waiting for conditions the spark does not need
grabbing every branch and holding none
charge: what wants to be started that you keep filing under someday?
voice_note: fresh, quick. this one is appetite; ask what their hands have been itching for.

name: two of wands
symbols: the world held small in one palm
one wand bolted to the wall, one held
looking out from a castle already owned
themes: the view from safety toward the larger life
planning as a form of longing
the domain that fits and confines
shadow: mapping the voyage forever instead of sailing
mistaking the balcony for the world
charge: you already hold the small version. what is stopping the larger one?
voice_note: note what they built, then look where they look — the reading is in the horizon, not the castle.

name: three of wands
symbols: ships already sent, still small on the water
back turned to the viewer
three wands planted like a claim
themes: the waiting after the committed act
watching what you set in motion come or not come home
expansion past the edge of control
shadow: standing at the shore instead of building the next thing
confusing watching with participating
charge: your ships are out. what are you doing with the waiting?
voice_note: patient register. honor what was already risked before asking about the next risk.

name: four of wands
symbols: a garland strung between four posts
figures dancing outside the castle walls
a threshold decorated for crossing
themes: a pause built for celebrating
home as something raised, not found
the milestone that deserves witnesses
shadow: skipping every ceremony because the work is never done
building the house and never throwing the party
charge: what have you finished that no one — including you — ever toasted?
voice_note: light, festive undertone. find the uncelebrated thing; the ache lives there.

name: five of wands
symbols: five staves raised in a scrum
no blood anywhere in the scene
everyone swinging, no one aimed
themes: friction that is really unspent energy
the argument standing in for the conversation
competition among people on the same side
shadow: fighting everything except the real opponent
loving the noise because silence has questions in it
charge: which of your battles is real, and which is just somewhere to put the heat?
voice_note: keep humor near. this one is a scuffle, not a war — ask what the noise is covering.

name: six of wands
symbols: a rider wreathed, mid-parade
the crowd's staves raised around the horse
victory carried past faces at street level
themes: recognition arriving in public
the win that others need to see to make real
leading from one length ahead
shadow: needing the parade more than the victory
the crowd's staves double as spears if the horse stumbles
charge: who is the applause for — the work, or the fear of what happens when it stops?
voice_note: grant the win fully first. only then ask what it weighs.

name: seven of wands
symbols: one figure on the high ground
six staves rising from below the frame
mismatched boots planted anyway
themes: defending the position lately claimed
the advantage of ground over numbers
conviction under pressure
shadow: defending by reflex what is no longer worth the hill
seeing challengers where there are questions
charge: is this hill still yours to hold, or just the one you happen to be standing on?
voice_note: respect the stance. the read is whether the fight is current or inherited.

name: eight of wands
symbols: eight staves in flight, no hands on them
open sky over a settled river
everything at once after nothing for so long
themes: the sudden unblocking
news and motion arriving together
speed that must simply be ridden
shadow: mistaking velocity for direction
answering everything the hour it lands
charge: when it all starts moving at once, what will you refuse to drop?
voice_note: quick tempo. this one is wind; ask what they will steer by.

name: nine of wands
symbols: a bandaged head, still upright
eight staves planted like a fence behind
eyes checking the road both ways
themes: the last watch before the finish
wariness earned the hard way
the strength found after the strength runs out
shadow: guarding a gate no one is coming for
letting the old wound do all the deciding
charge: you are nearly through. who told you it has to be alone from here?
voice_note: gentle with this one; every flinch has a history. name the endurance before the fence.

name: ten of wands
symbols: ten staves bundled against the chest
the town close enough to see
a back bent by choice as much as load
themes: carrying everything because someone has to
the finish line reached under full weight
competence become a trap
shadow: refusing to set one stave down as a matter of identity
arriving home too spent to live there
charge: which of these were ever yours to carry — and which did you pick up so no one else had to?
voice_note: name the load without calling it weakness. the town is in sight; ask what almost-home means.

name: page of wands
symbols: a staff studied like a letter
desert behind, unbothered
a hat too plumed for the errand
themes: enthusiasm before evidence
the announcement of a self still forming
curiosity with nowhere yet to put itself
shadow: a spark that restarts instead of catching
playing the beginner to dodge the test
charge: what are you on the verge of saying out loud about who you are becoming?
voice_note: playful. this one is a message from their younger appetite — deliver it, do not grade it.

name: knight of wands
symbols: a horse rearing mid-departure
flames stitched onto the tunic
the desert crossed at a gallop
themes: pursuit at full commitment
the charge that clears obstacles and furniture alike
passion as a mode of travel
shadow: leaving as a reflex when depth is asked
the third fresh start this year
charge: what are you riding toward — and what keeps getting left at the last camp?
voice_note: match the energy, then slow one beat. the question is what survives their speed.

name: queen of wands
symbols: a sunflower held like a scepter
the black cat sitting exactly front and center
a throne facing fully forward
themes: warmth that commands a room without asking
confidence with roots in appetite
the shadow kept as a pet, not a secret
shadow: burning bright for an audience and cold at home
charisma spent so no one looks closer
charge: who gets the fire, and who gets the ashes at the end of the day?
voice_note: meet her straight-on; this one respects directness. ask about the cat eventually.

name: king of wands
symbols: a salamander biting its own tail on the throne
the crown shaped like flames
leaning forward as if about to stand
themes: vision worn as office
fire matured into direction
the leader who cannot fully sit down
shadow: needing every fire to be one's own arson or rescue
vision that stopped taking questions
charge: the kingdom runs. why can you still not sit all the way back?
voice_note: peer register, not subject. ask what the next mountain is for.
